Having worked on the customer and project management side I feel it will take a while for this situation. ChatGPT/AI has definitely made deep inroads in to every space but the human review element still remains. It is imperative that we learn how to use ChatGPT for getting our jobs done with it’s help. I work for one of the biggest pharma in the world and live in Boston. I was the earliest adopter of GPT for my personal use, be it writing research papers or be it analysis of companies financial statements for my own investment decisions. So when our department head asked if anyone is interested in assessing the use of AI in doing our job, I volunteered for it. It’s almost 2 years I’ve been trying to use my time even if short periods, I or 3 other colleagues have hardly made any progress. None of us 4 people are software engineers, v r just medical scientists and exploring ChatGPT for making our tasks shorter. On other hand software engineers from our vendors (specialists and full time workers on this task), created a wonderful product for other department’s reducing their task, but without human review those product are not worth or could be scary. So, a lot refinement is needed for them to make human completely dispensable.
